newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU ministers fail to agree on Synergy programme.
newsitem.headline: EU ministers fail to agree on Synergy programme.

text.p: European Union energy ministers failed on Tuesday to reach a deal on the Synergy programme on international cooperation, COM(96)194, due to different views on the budget.
Energy Commissioner Christos Papoutsis expressed deep disappointment that a "few million Ecus" had prevented a deal.
The ministers asked COREPER to work on the dossier and Papoutsis said he hoped an agreement would be reached in the next few weeks.
The Commission had originally proposed a budget of 50 million Ecus over five years.

The Irish presidency had tried a compromise proposal with a budget of 20 million Ecus over two years but several member states, including Germany, Britain and France, were only willing to agree to a budget of 10 million.
